name: Dil Ki Baat — Daily Orchestration Blueprint

nodes.name: Daily 7:30 AM IST Trigger
nodes.notes: Set timezone to Asia/Kolkata; trigger daily.

nodes.name: Fetch trend candidates
nodes.notes: Connect only permitted, reliable trend/news sources. Normalize and timestamp results.

nodes.name: AI topic & content planner
nodes.notes: Call your chosen LLM endpoint with brand rules; generate a plan for up to two daily posts.

nodes.name: Save drafts
nodes.notes: Insert ideas and drafts with status needs_review. Do not publish automatically in review mode.

nodes.name: Build morning report
nodes.notes: Aggregate prior-day account/post insights and draft queue status.

nodes.name: Send WhatsApp report
nodes.notes: Connect WhatsApp Business Cloud API or a supported provider; recipient opt-in and approved template may be required.

meta.note: Blueprint only; nodes need credentials, versions, and actual connections before activation.
